# Figures made for climate & hydrology

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=F, message=F, warning=F)

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(units)
library(raster)
library(rgeos)
library(tmap)
library(lubridate)
library(jpeg)
library(pdftools)
```


```{r}
# Drought Map.

# Earth's water capacity and degree of saturation (gwb_sssdev and gwb_sssrel)
# The earth's water capacity is defined as the storage capacity in the ground and groundwater # zones compared with the highest saturation simulated with the HBV model in the period # 1981-2010. The degree of saturation is given as a percentage of water saturation in soil. The # percentage is the ratio between the current simulated water stock and the maximum simulated # water stock in the period 1981-2010. The calculations are made with the HBV model.

watershed_fdro <- Catchment_Climate %>% filter(par == "gwb_sssrel") %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(site_id, year, monthly_mean, monthly_min, monthly_max)) %>%
  group_by(site_id, year) %>% 
  summarise(annual_mean = mean(monthly_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            annual_min = mean(monthly_min, na.rm = TRUE),
            annual_max = mean(monthly_max, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(annual_mean, annual_max)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "year", values_from = "annual_min")

watershed700 <- full_join(watershed70, watershed_fdro)

# Plot Figure
tmap_mode(mode = c("view")) # Set for interactive viewing. 
tmap_options(check.and.fix = TRUE)  # for error. 

tm <- tm_shape(watershed700) +
  tm_polygons(c("2017", "2018", "2019", "2020"),
				title=c("2017", "2018", "2019", "2020"), legend.show = FALSE) +
  tm_facets(as.layers = T)

tm
## save an image ("plot" mode)
tmap_save(tm, filename = "Figures/Catchments_drought.html")
```


# Climate & Hydrology : All Rivers over all years
```{r}
Climate <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Intermediate/Climate_processed.csv")

# Climate
Climate_Plotter <- Climate %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(site_id, Date), names_to = "par", values_to = "monthly_mean") %>% 
  filter(grepl("rr|tm", par)) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(Date),month = month(Date, label = TRUE), day = day(Date)) %>%
  mutate(day = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Date = paste(year, month, day, sep="-") %>% ymd() %>% as.Date()) %>% 
  distinct()

Climate_Plotter$par <- factor(Climate_Plotter$par, 
                       levels = c("tm", "rr"),
                       labels = c("mean tm (C)", "sum rr (mm)"))

Plot <- Climate_Plotter %>%   
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = monthly_mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, color = "gray70") +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", color = "black") + 
  ylab("Estimate") + xlab(NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~par,  scales = "free", ncol=1) +
  theme_bw() 

ggsave("Figures/Climate2.pdf", Plot, width = 5, height = 3.5, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Climate2.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Climate2.jpeg")


# Hydrology
Hydro_Plotter <- Climate %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(site_id, Date), names_to = "par", values_to = "monthly_mean") %>% 
  filter(grepl("gwb_q|gwb_sssrel", par)) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(Date),month = month(Date, label = TRUE), day = day(Date)) %>%
  mutate(day = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Date = paste(year, month, day, sep="-") %>% ymd() %>% as.Date()) %>% 
  distinct()

Hydro_Plotter$par <- factor(Hydro_Plotter$par, 
                       levels = c("gwb_q", "gwb_sssrel"),
                       labels = c("gwb_q (mm)", "mean gwb_sssrel (%)"))

Plot <- Hydro_Plotter %>%   
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = monthly_mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, color = "gray70") +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", color = "black") + 
  ylab("Estimate") + xlab(NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~par,  scales = "free", ncol=1) +
  theme_bw() 

ggsave("Figures/Hydro3.pdf", Plot, width = 5, height = 3.5, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Hydro3.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Hydro3.jpeg")
```

# Climate by groupings
```{r}
Ecoregions <- read_csv("Clean_Data/Water_Chem_Climate.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_id, rapportnavn, okoregion) %>% 
  mutate(Group = "incomplete") %>% 
  mutate(Group =ifelse(grepl("Bjo|Femangerelva|Komagelva|Lahpojohka|Lera|Maskejohka|Mistra|Setninga|Skallelva|Stabburselva|Store|Tegninga|Tjo",rapportnavn), "'18/'20", Group)) %>% 
  mutate(Group =ifelse(grepl("Aslestadai|Bolaselva|Breineset|Daleaa|	
Eiteraga|Flakstadvag|Halandselva|Imsa|Homla|Luru|Mammakjosen|Kobbvag|Molandsana|Nordaa|Nordfolda|Oydgardselva|Nodalselva|Sandvatn|Sanddola|Lislefjoddai|Rorholtfjorden|Rotsund|Simskardelva|Skjeggedalsana|Stordalselva|Susna|Vesterdalsani|Vatnedalselva",rapportnavn), "'19/'21", Group)) %>% 
  mutate(Group =ifelse(grepl("Atna04|Atna11|Dorae",rapportnavn), "'18/'19/'20/'21", Group)) %>% drop_na() %>% distinct()


Climate_Plotter_Groups <- full_join(Climate_Plotter,Ecoregions)


# 2018/2020
Climate_Plotter_18_20 <- full_join(Climate_Plotter,Ecoregions) %>% 
  filter(Group %in% c("'18/'20")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018", "2020")) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(Date), month = month(Date, label = TRUE), day = day(Date))

Plot1 <- Climate_Plotter_18_20 %>%   
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = monthly_mean, group = factor(year), color = factor(year))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha= 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#FFCC66","#264EFF")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = F) + 
  ylab("Estimate") + xlab(NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~par, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() + labs(color ="year")

ggsave("Figures/Climate_18_20.pdf", Plot1, width = 5, height = 3.5, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Climate_18_20.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Climate_18_20.jpeg")


# 2019/2021
Climate_Plotter_19_21 <- full_join(Climate_Plotter,Ecoregions) %>% 
  filter(Group %in% c("'19/'21")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2019", "2021")) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(Date), month = month(Date, label = TRUE), day = day(Date))

Plot2 <- Climate_Plotter_19_21 %>%   
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = monthly_mean, group = factor(year), color = factor(year))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha= 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#3399FF", "#FF8000")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = F) + 
  ylab("Estimate") + xlab(NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~par, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() + labs(color ="year")

ggsave("Figures/Climate_19_21.pdf", Plot2, width = 5, height = 3.5, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Climate_19_21.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Climate_19_21.jpeg")


# 2018/19/20/21
Climate_Plotter_ALL <- full_join(Climate_Plotter,Ecoregions) %>% 
  filter(Group %in% c("'18/'19/'20/'21")) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c("2018", "2019", "2020", "2021")) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(Date), month = month(Date, label = TRUE), day = day(Date))

Plot3 <- Climate_Plotter_ALL %>%   
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = monthly_mean, group = factor(year), color = factor(year))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha= 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#FFCC66","#3399FF","#264EFF", "#FF8000")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = F) + 
  ylab("Estimate") + xlab(NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~par, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() + labs(color ="year")

ggsave("Figures/Climate_ALL.pdf", Plot3, width = 5, height = 3.5, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
bitmap <- pdf_render_page("Figures/Climate_ALL.pdf", page = 1, dpi = 300)
jpeg::writeJPEG(bitmap, "Figures/Climate_ALL.jpeg")
```
